self_fix_allowed: replacing an empty bag-in-box syrup bag
checking that the CO2 tank valve is open and the gauge isn't in the red
checking the ice level in the ice bin
cleaning or soaking nozzles and diffusers
checking the power plug and resetting a tripped breaker once
self_fix_forbidden: opening any panel or cover that needs a tool
safety_topics: CO2 asphyxiation in enclosed spaces: if a CO2 leak is suspected (hissing, headache, dizziness), ventilate and leave the area
high-pressure gas: never loosen fittings on a pressurized CO2 line or carbonator
water near electrical parts: unplug before touching wet areas around the machine
sanitation: mold in nozzles and a dirty ice bin are a health hazard; sanitize before serving
